display_name: Caregiver Income Impact & Lost Earnings Estimator
purpose: Financial cost of unpaid caregiving: direct income loss during the care period, the retirement savings gap from missed 401(k) contributions plus their lost compounding, the cumulative cost of a post-care career setback, and a flagged Social Security reduction estimate, in integer USD cents. The SSA contribution and benefit base and the SSA average annual benefit are selected from a pinned vintage table by an explicit as_of date (the node reads no clock). Ported from ApexLogics display_number #117 (117-caregiver-income-impact, al_id AL-124, CC BY 4.0); DIFFERS-D1..D5 in the porting payload, three modelling constants UNGROUNDED.
